name: com.engagemii/citation-watch
title: Engagemii AI Visibility Data
description: AI visibility of 82M+ companies: scores, AI crawler reads, full records. Free 500 and 1M datasets.

tools.name: aeo_score
tools.description: Get the Engagemii AEO score (0-10) for any company domain, with the six on-page and six off-page signals each rated Weak, Fair, Good or Strong, and the llms.txt audit verdict. Drawn from the Engagemii Index of more than 81 million companies. Free, no auth.

domain.description: Company domain or URL, e.g. example.com

tools.name: aeo_audit
tools.description: Run a LIVE AEO audit of a site right now: fresh fetch of the homepage, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, and about page, scored on the six on-page categories with concrete recommendations. Differs from aeo_score, which returns the stored score from the index; that score updates when Engagemii next reads the site. Free, no auth, up to 5 live audits per hour.

domain.description: Company domain or URL, e.g. example.com

tools.name: brand_profile
tools.description: Full public profile for a scored company: score breakdown, category, geography, detected platform, social profiles, AI-crawler visit counts. Free, no auth.

domain.description: The company's website, e.g. example.com (a full URL is accepted)

tools.name: company_verify
tools.description: Verify a company's facts against the Engagemii record, with sources. Pass the company's website (or its name) and, optionally, the values you want checked: name, address, phone, website, hours, category, socials. For every fact Engagemii holds, the answer gives the value, where it was read (the company's own site, the verified owner, an SEC filing or the directory record), and the date it was stored or last confirmed. Each value you pass comes back as match, differs or not_known; not_known means no value is held, never a guess. Also returns whether the company has claimed its Engagemii page, its page URL and its agent card. Reads stored records only: free, no auth, no live fetch.

domain.description: The company's website, e.g. acme.com (a full URL is accepted). Preferred over name.

name.description: The company's name, when the website is not known. The best match is used and others are listed.

check.description: Values to check against the record. Each comes back as match, differs or not_known.

address.description: Address as one line, e.g. 12 Main St, Garden City, NY 11530

hours.description: Opening hours, e.g. Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00 or Mon-Fri 9am-5pm

socials.description: Social profile URLs: an object by network (linkedin, instagram, facebook, twitter, tiktok, youtube) or a list of URLs

tools.name: dataset_sample
tools.description: Sample rows from the Engagemii dataset in exactly the 113 columns of a purchased file, in the same order: the first 15 rows of the free sample (500 US companies, all 113 columns, the same sample as on Databricks Marketplace); the full file downloads as Excel or CSV at engagemii.com/aeo/data after a work email. Always the same rows. Free, no auth.

tools.name: citation_watch
tools.description: Which brands AI assistants name right now. Every 30 minutes from 6am to 11pm ET, Engagemii puts a real question that names no brand to ChatGPT, Meta AI and Gemini with live web search and records the first brand each names, alongside that brand's standing AI visibility score (computed before the question was asked). Most checks ask about what is trending on Google (kind trending); about 1 in 4 is a buying question in a business category (kind buying). Returns checks from the last 48 hours, newest first, each naming its engine. Filter by business category (for example Technology or Legal), by words in the question (topic, for example crm), by engine or by kind. Free, no auth.

category.description: Business category, case-insensitive substring, e.g. Legal, Technology, Finance & Insurance, Trending. Not a topic: use topic for words in the question.

topic.description: Words that must appear in the question, case-insensitive, e.g. crm or help desk.

engine.description: Only checks put to this engine.

kind.description: buying: a fixed buying question by category; trending: a question about what is trending on Google.

limit.description: How many checks to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

tools.name: ai_readstream
tools.description: Which AI engines are reading the business web right now. Server-side, IP-verified crawler logs across one of the largest networks of business pages online. Returns per-engine reads over the last ten minutes, the last 24 hours and all time, plus a daily series. Free, no auth. Answers questions such as which AI crawler is most active, how two engines compare, and whether AI reading is rising.

days.description: How many days of the daily series to return, 0 to 30. Default 7.

tools.name: free_kit
tools.description: Request the FREE Customized Fix Kit for a domain. There is one kit and it is the free Customized Fix Kit: ready-to-install fix files written from your own site, plus a PDF audit. Flow: pass the owner's email; Engagemii emails a verification link; after the owner clicks it the kit is built and the download link is emailed automatically. Kits are queued, so delivery is by email rather than in-chat. One kit per domain; repeat requests resend the stored kit.

email.description: The site owner's email (the verification link and the kit go there)

owner_confirmed.description: Confirm with the user that this is their own brand. Agencies working on client sites should use the data portal (engagemii.com/aeo/data) instead.

tools.name: connect_tracker
tools.description: Set up Engagemii AI-crawler monitoring for a site the user owns. The tracker key goes only to the verified owner of the site: if the email given is the site's verified owner, Engagemii emails it the site's tracker key and install steps (Node/Express, Next.js, PHP, Cloudflare Worker or WordPress); the key is never returned in the chat, and a site has one key. Otherwise the answer explains how to claim and verify the site at engagemii.com/portal/brand. The site shows as connected only after the tracker reports its first AI crawler visit. Terms of the free service: Engagemii licenses the AI-crawler activity data the tracker collects, in aggregated form and, unless the owner opts out in portal settings, identified by their domain. The tracker records bot visits only, never human visitors.

email.description: The site owner's email (required). The key is emailed there only when it is the site's verified owner.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Query the scored dataset with filters (industries, states, score range, scope us|all). Returns up to 100 light rows. Requires an Engagemii data API key.

states.description: US states by name or two-letter code, e.g. Texas or TX

scoreMin.description: Lowest AI visibility score to include, 0 to 10

scoreMax.description: Highest AI visibility score to include, 0 to 10

scope.description: us = verified US companies; all = worldwide

api_key.description: Your Engagemii data API key (edk_...). Only needed when the key is not already sent as a request header.

tools.name: data_signup
tools.description: Create a free Engagemii data account, or sign in to an existing one, with just an email address. There is no password: we send a one-click sign-in link (valid 30 days) to the address. When the user clicks it they are signed in and the address is verified, which activates the account's API key (edk_...). The key is then shown at https://engagemii.com/portal/data/connect and unlocks search_companies and data_records. Use the email address the user gives you.

email.description: The user's email address. The sign-in link is sent here.

tools.name: data_records
tools.description: Pull full licensed records from the Engagemii dataset (the same 113 columns as a purchased file, in the same order, fingerprinted; every column is filled where we hold the data, the same as in a data file). Metered: every record returned uses one unit of the account's purchased API quota, public companies included; the response states unitsPerRow and unitsSpent. Asking for public companies only (publicCompanies "only") costs 10 units a record and runs only with acceptUnitsPerRow 10; without it the tool answers with the cost and charges nothing. Page with offset: pass the nextOffset of the previous answer until hasMore is false. A filter value that is not recognised is refused with the allowed values and nothing is charged. Returns 25 records by default and at most 100 per call. Larger pulls are available through the REST API at https://api.engagemii.com/api/v1/data/records with the same key. Any returned record whose score is more than 30 days old is queued for a fresh rescore. Requires an Engagemii data API key.

industries.description: Categories, any case: Technology, Healthcare, Real Estate, ...

states.description: US states by name or code

countries.description: Country names or ISO codes (worldwide rows)

scoreMin.description: Lowest AI visibility score to include, 0 to 10

scoreMax.description: Highest AI visibility score to include, 0 to 10

scope.description: us = verified US companies; all = worldwide

publicCompanies.description: public companies only, 10 units a record

acceptUnitsPerRow.description: confirm the public rate (10) for publicCompanies "only"

offset.description: 0 for the first page, then the previous answer's nextOffset

limit.description: records to draw, 1 unit each. Default 25, max 100 in-chat.

api_key.description: Your Engagemii data API key (edk_...). Only needed when the key is not already sent as a request header.

tools.name: data_orders
tools.description: List the data orders on the account behind an Engagemii data API key: order number, records, date, status (preparing, ready or pending), and a download link for each ready file (a delivered file never changes). The same as GET https://api.engagemii.com/api/v1/data/orders. Requires an Engagemii data API key.

api_key.description: Your Engagemii data API key (edk_...). Only needed when the key is not already sent as a request header.

tools.name: kit_download
tools.description: For a fix kit bought before October 2026 (paid checkout), receive every Customized Fix Kit file plus the badge embed as plain text. Requires the Stripe session id (cs_...) from the checkout success URL.

session_id.description: The Stripe checkout session id from the success URL, starts with cs_
